tests_final.scope: full discovery per runtime; never cross-runtime joblib

papers.ExtraTrees: Geurts, Ernst, Wehenkel (2006), Machine Learning63:3–42; https://doi.org/10.1007/s10994-006-6226-1
papers.conformal: Angelopoulos, Bates (2023), Foundations and Trends in Machine Learning; https://arxiv.org/html/2107.07511v6
papers.gradient_boosting: Friedman (2001), Annals of Statistics29:1189–1232; https://doi.org/10.1214/aos/1013203451; HGB is sklearn histogram implementation, not exact paper reproduction
papers.shrinkage: Ledoit, Wolf (2004), Journal of Multivariate Analysis88:365–411; https://doi.org/10.1016/S0047-259X(03)00096-4
papers.tree_priority: Grinsztajn, Oyallon, Varoquaux (NeurIPS2022 benchmark); no motor-data performance guarantee

planned.seed_note: algorithm seeds only; no new motor or acquisition

rules.B1_B4: min raw distance / max(quantile95(min raw distances on known cal),eps); reject >1
rules.B2: min_c raw pooled distance / max(class own cal q95,eps); reject >1
rules.B3: pooled minimum raw / global cal q95; reject >1
rules.B5_B6: p_c=(1+count(cal_true_c raw_c >= raw_c(x)))/(n_c+1); reject max(p)<=.05; score=1-max(p)
rules.conformal_warning: exchangeability across motors/windows unproved; no5% deployment guarantee
rules.distance_unit: square root of quadratic form; knn mean5 Euclidean
rules.missing: NA/INCOMPLETE cell with reason; never borrow RPM/test/cal for fit
rules.routing: metadata RPM only; unsupported RPM rejected; no order tracking
